question: What is the value of [ (1)/(5) + {(1)/(7) of ((25)/(42) div (35)/(6)) -((4)/(7)times (6)/(5) div (54)/(63))} + (28)/(40)]
solution:
**Given:**

x=**[{{1} over 5} + left{{{1}over 7} of ({{25} over 42} div {{35} over 6}) - ({{4} over 7} times {{6} over 5} div {{54} over 63} )right} + {{28} over 40} ] **

**Formula Used:- **

BODMAS rule 

where B - Brackets, O - Order of powers, D - Division, M - Multiplication, A - Addition, and S - Subtraction

**Calculation:-**

⇒ BODMAS rule we have to solve from B to S

⇒ so we have to solve the bracket first

⇒ x=[{{1} over 5} + left{{{1}over 7} of ({{25} over 42} div {{35} over 6}) - ({{4} over 7} times {{6} over 5} div {{54} over 63} )right} +{{28} over 40}]​​​​​​

⇒ x=[{{1} over 5} + left{{{1}over 7} of ({{25} over 42} times {{6} over 35}) - ({{4} over 7} times {{6} over 5} times {{63} over54} )right} + {{28} over 40} ]

⇒ x=(1)/(5)+((1)/(7)times(5)/(49)-(4)/(5))+(28)/(40)

⇒ x=(1)/(5)+((5)/(343)-(4)/(5))+(28)/(40)

⇒ x=(1)/(5)+((-1347)/(1715))+(7)/(10)

⇒ x = (9)/(10)-(1347)/(1715)=(15435-13470)/(17150)=(1965)/(17150)=(3930)/(34300)
